title: Block input
statement: For $m\ge 7$, a sign-valued input $x$ with $2^m$ coordinates, and a block index $b<m$, the block input is the sign-valued vector of length $2m$ whose coordinate at position $j$ is the coordinate of $x$ selected by the block-coordinate construction for $(m,b,j)$.
caveat: The omitted block-coordinate definition prevents a more explicit description of the selected coordinates.
